mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may potentiate mefloquine's CNS effects and increase seizure risk through additive neurological effects; ginkgo also has antiplatelet properties that may enhance bleeding risk in patients with mefloquine-induced thrombocytopenia.
action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor closely for neurological symptoms, seizures, and bleeding manifestations; consider alternative antimalarial if ginkgo supplementation cannot be discontinued.
